blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Video compression at ultra-low bitrates remains challenging due to the loss of perceptually important details under limited bit budgets. Recent generative video compression methods leverage pretrained video priors to improve perceptual quality and temporal coherence, but many follow a compress-then-generate paradigm, where generative priors are primarily exploited during reconstruction. Moreover, representations learned for generation and reconstruction are not inherently optimized for entropy coding.
  In this work, we propose \method, which adapts pretrained video representations into compression-oriented representations while preserving their reconstruction capability. Specifically, we adapt the pretrained causal video VAE of MiniMax-H3 into a discrete video tokenizer and develop a small autoregressive entropy model that captures local and global token dependencies, with grouped prediction for parallel decoding. To further improve coding efficiency, we jointly optimize the tokenizer and entropy model using a differentiable rate surrogate, allowing rate gradients to adapt token assignments toward lower coding costs while preserving reconstruction quality. Experiments on UVG, MCL-JCV, and HEVC Class B demonstrate superior perceptual rate--distortion performance, achieving BD-LPIPS savings of 82.2\%--87.5\% and BD-DISTS savings of 78.3\%--85.0\% relative to GLC-Video.
blocks.zh:
超低比特速率的视频压缩仍然具有挑战性,因为在有限的比特预算下失去了感知性重要的细节. 近期的基因视频压缩方法利用预先训练的视频前传,提高知觉质量和时间一致性,但很多都遵循了压缩-当时基因的范式,其中基因前传主要在重建期间被利用. 此外,为生成和重建所学得的表示法在本质上并没有被优化,以用于 en编码.
在这部作品中,我们提出\方法,它将经过预先训练的视频演示修改为面向压缩的演示,同时保留其重建能力. 具体地说,我们把MiniMax-H3的预训因果录影带VAE改编成离散录影带标注器,并开发出一个能捕捉局部和全球信物依赖性的小自旋式演算模型,并附有平行解码的分组预测. 为了进一步提高编码效率,我们联合优化了代码器和 en模型,使用一种不同速率的代码,使代码梯度能够使代码任务适应较低的编码成本,同时保持重建质量. 在UVG,MCL-JCV,HEVC Class B的实验中,表现出了优异的知觉率-扭曲性能,相对于GLC-Video,实现了BD-LPIPS的82.2\%-87.5\%和BD-DISTS的78.3\%-85.0\%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video compression at ultra-low bitrates remains challenging because using only limited information, some perceptual details can be lost, and results in blurred textures.
Generative video compression (GVC) addresses this challenge by leveraging learned generative priors to reconstruct perceptually plausible details.
Recent GVC methods [ 26 , 5 , 24 , 12 , 29 ] use pretrained video generative models as decoders, conditioning video reconstruction on information transmitted in the compressed bitstream.
blocks.zh:
超低比特率的视频压缩仍然具有挑战性,因为仅使用有限的信息,一些能感知到的细节可能会丢失,并导致纹理模糊.
基因视频压缩(GVC)通过利用所学的基因学前科来重建概念上可信的细节来应对这一挑战.
最近的GVC方法 [26, 5, 24, 12, 29] 使用被预先训练的视频基因模型作为解码器,在压缩比特流中传输的信息上对视频重建进行调节.

blocks.en:
However, representations learned for generation and reconstruction are not inherently optimized for entropy coding.
Many GVC methods follow a compress-then-generate paradigm, where video latents are first compressed into compact representations and then reconstructed using pretrained generative priors.
While effective in improving perceptual quality, these methods primarily exploit generative priors during reconstruction, without directly addressing how pretrained generative representations can be adapted for efficient coding.
This raises a natural question: can pretrained video representations be adapted into compression-oriented representations while preserving their reconstruction capability?
blocks.zh:
然而,为生成和重建而学得的表示法在本质上并没有被优化为对等编码.
许多GVC方法都遵循了当时的压缩-再生模式,其中视频潜伏被先被压缩成紧凑的表示并再用被预先训练的基因前传来重建.
这些方法虽然有效地提高了知觉质量,但主要利用了重建期间的遗传学前科,而没有直接解决如何调整预先训练的遗传学表现以有效编码。
这自然提出了一个问题:预先训练的视频表现能否在保持其重建能力的同时被改编成以压缩为导向的表现?

blocks.en:
To address this challenge, we propose h3vc , which directly entropy codes the spatiotemporal representations learned by the pretrained causal video VAE of MiniMax-H3 [ 19 ] .
To get a reconstructive and compressive representation,
we first adapt the pretrained VAE into a discrete video tokenizer, preserving its reconstruction capability while converting continuous video representations into discrete tokens.
To efficiently compress discrete video tokens, we develop a small autoregressive entropy model that captures local and global dependencies for accurate probability estimation. To reduce sequential decoding complexity, we adopt a grouped prediction scheme that enables parallel token prediction within each group.
However, training the tokenizer and entropy model separately does not explicitly optimize the learned representations for compression. The tokenizer is optimized for reconstruction, producing token distributions that are not necessarily low coding cost, while the entropy model can only learn to predict these fixed distributions without influencing the token assignments. To address this limitation, we introduce a differentiable rate surrogate that propagates rate gradients to the encoder, enabling joint rate–distortion optimization to adapt token assignments for lower coding costs while preserving reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这一挑战,我们提议h3vc,它直接将预受训练的由MiniMax-H3的因果视频VAE[19]所学到的spatiotepolar表示编码.
为了得到重建与压缩的代表,
我们首先将经过预先训练的VAE改装成离散的视频表示器,同时保留其重建能力,同时将连续的视频表示器转换为离散的表示器.
为了高效地压缩离散的视频符号,我们开发出一个能捕捉局部和全球依赖性的自旋回旋回旋模型,用于准确的概率估计. 为了减少相继解码的复杂性,我们采用了一个分组预测方案,使每个组内能够进行平行的符号预测。
然而,单独训练活化剂和活化模型并不能明确优化所学表现来进行压缩. 活化器被优化用于重建,产生不一定低编码成本的活化器分配,而活化器模型只能学会在不影响活化器分配的情况下预测这些固定分布. 为了应对这一限制,我们引入了一种不同费率代用法,将费率梯度传播到编码器上,使联合费率-扭曲优化能够适应代号任务,降低编码成本,同时保持重建质量。

blocks.en: Experiments on UVG, MCL-JCV, and HEVC Class B demonstrate that h3vc achieves superior perceptual rate–distortion performance compared with existing video codecs, with BD-LPIPS savings of 82.2%–87.5% and BD-DISTS savings of 78.3%–85.0% relative to GLC-Video [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 关于UVG、MCL-JCV和HEVC的实验 B类显示h3vc与现有的视频解码器相比,实现了优异的感知率-扭曲性能,与GLC-Video相比,BD-LPIPS节省了82.2~87.5%,BD-DISTS节省了78.3~85.0%.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Generative video compression (GVC) leverages learned generative priors to improve perceptual reconstruction at low bitrates. Early approaches employ perceptual and adversarial training to recover realistic details [ 27 , 16 ] . Subsequent methods explore compression in generative latent spaces, including GLC-Video [ 21 ] , which performs conditional latent coding, and GVC1D [ 32 ] , which combines compact one-dimensional representations with short- and long-term temporal context. More recently, pretrained video generative models have been incorporated into GVC to improve perceptual quality and temporal coherence, including GNVC-VD [ 14 ] , CGVC [ 2 ] , ZeroGVC [ 5 ] , and Free-GVC [ 12 ] . These approaches demonstrate the effectiveness of generative priors for video reconstruction, motivating further exploration of their learned representations for compression.
Unlike approaches that primarily exploit pretrained generative priors to refine compressed representations, h3vc directly adapts pretrained video representations for entropy-constrained compression, integrating the learned generative representations into the coding process itself.
blocks.zh:
基因视频压缩(GVC)利用所学到的基因前传,在低比特率下改善知觉重建. 早期方法采用感知和对抗性培训,以收回现实的细节[27、16]。 随后的方法探索了基因潜入空间的压缩,包括进行有条件潜入编码的GLC-Video [21]和将紧凑的一维表示与短期和长期时间上下文相结合的GVC1D [32]. 最近,经过预先培训的视频基因模型已被纳入全球价值链,以提高视觉质量和时间一致性,包括GNVC-VD[14],CGVC[2],ZeroGVC[5],和Free-GVC[12]. 这些方法显示了视频重建的基因前科的有效性,促使人们进一步探索其所学到的压缩表达.
与主要利用先入为主的基因前缀来完善压缩表达方式的方法不同,h3vc直接将先入为主的视频前缀用于肽-受压压缩,将所学的基因前缀融入编码过程本身.

blocks.en: Direct entropy coding of learned video representations has been explored by Habibian et al. [ 6 ] and VCT [ 17 ] . Habibian et al. learn spatiotemporal representations using a 3D convolutional autoencoder, while VCT exploits temporal dependencies among frame-wise latents through Transformer-based entropy modeling. More recently, pretrained video representations have been investigated for direct video coding. GLC-Video [ 21 ] evaluates the pretrained 3D VAE of CogVideoX [ 28 ] , showing that its compact spatiotemporal representations do not necessarily yield better rate–distortion performance than 2D representations.
blocks.zh: Habibian等人[6] 和VCT[17] 探索了对所学视频表达方式的直接活性编码。 Habibian等人使用3D分解自编码器学习spatiotepotor表示法,而VCT则通过基于变形器的等离子模型利用帧潜伏物之间的时间依赖性. 最近,对经过预先培训的视频展示进行了直接视频编码调查。 GLC-Video [21]评价了CogVideoX的预训3D VAE [28],显示其紧凑的spatiental differentation不一定产生比2D differentation更好的速率-扭曲性能.

blocks.en:
Recent methods further explore pretrained discrete video representations. TVC [ 33 ] builds on pretrained Cosmos tokenizers [ 4 ] , combining two discrete and continuous token streams for perceptual reconstruction. ProGVC [ 10 ] builds on the InfinityStar video tokenizer [ 13 ] and employs multi-scale autoregressive modeling for entropy coding and generation, enabling bitrate adaptation through progressive transmission of coarse-to-fine token scales.
In contrast, h3vc directly adapts the pretrained MiniMax-H3 [ 19 ] causal video VAE into a single-stream discrete representation, without relying on an additional continuous stream or generative completion of token scales. More importantly, h3vc jointly optimizes token assignments and their conditional probability distribution, enabling rate and reconstruction constraints to guide token assignments toward lower coding costs while preserving reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh:
最近的方法进一步探索了预先训练的离散视频展示. TVC [33] 以预先训练的宇宙活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化 ProGVC [10] 以"无穷之星"(Infinity Star)视频标注器[13]为基础,并采用多尺度自旋模型来进行等效编码和生成,通过粗到细的标注尺度的渐进传输来使比特率适应.
相形之下,h3vc直接将被预先训练过的MiniMax-H3 [19]因果视频VAE调整为单流离散代表,而无需依赖附加的连续流或基因完成符标. 更重要的是,h3vc联合优化了象征性任务及其有条件的概率分布,使得率和重建限制能够引导象征性任务降低编码成本,同时保持重建质量。

blocks.en: 3.2 Autoregressive Entropy Model
blocks.zh: 3.2 自动递减式Entropy模型

blocks.en: After obtaining the discrete video token grid 𝐳 ∈ { 0 , … , N − 1 } T y × H y × W y \mathbf{z}\in\{0,\ldots,N-1\}^{T_{y}\times H_{y}\times W_{y}} in Stage I, we train an autoregressive entropy model to estimate the conditional probability of each token index for entropy coding, rather than directly storing it. Figure 4 illustrates the entropy model.
blocks.zh: 在获得离散的视频标志网格后, z {0, ..., N- 1 } T y → H y → mathbf{zin\{0,\ldots, N-1\}^{t_{y}\times 时间 W_{y}} 在第一阶段中,我们训练出自旋回旋回旋式模型,以估计每个指针指数的附加概率来进行回旋回旋编码,而不是直接存储. 图4显示了 en模型.

blocks.en:
For each token index z i z_{i} , we estimate its conditional probability q ψ ​ ( z i ∣ C i ) q_{\psi}(z_{i}\mid C_{i}) using two complementary sources of context.
The local context consists of previously decoded tokens from the spatially corresponding window in preceding latent frames and earlier groups within the current window, capturing temporal and short-range spatial dependencies.
To capture dependencies beyond the local window, we further introduce a global context through a fixed-size one-dimensional memory bank adapted from [ 31 ] .
Previously decoded latent frames are summarized to update the memory bank, while learnable query tokens retrieve global information for subsequent predictions.
Together, the local and global context provide complementary information for estimating the probability of z i z_{i} .
blocks.zh:
对于每个令牌索引 z i z i},我们用两个互补的上下文源来估计其有条件的概率 q (z i ∣ C i) q_{\psi} (z_{i}\mid C_{i}).
本地上下文包括先前从空间对应窗口中解码到之前潜在框架的信号符和当前窗口中较早的组合,捕捉时间和短程空间依赖关系.
为了捕捉本地窗口之外的依赖性,我们通过从[31]改编的固定尺寸一维内存库,进一步引入了全球背景.
先前已解码的潜在帧被汇总以更新内存库,而可学习的查询符则检索全球信息以进行后期预测.
当地及全球背景共同为估算z i z_{i}的概率提供了补充信息.

blocks.en: Fully sequential autoregressive prediction requires one decoding step per token, resulting in substantial latency. To enable parallel prediction, we partition each latent frame into non-overlapping 8 × 8 8\times 8 windows, each further divided into four parity groups indexed by g ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } g\in\{0,1,2,3\} . The groups are decoded in frame-major order, with prediction round r = 4 ​ t + g r=4t+g for group g g in latent frame t t . Tokens within the same group are modeled as conditionally independent and predicted in parallel across all windows. The resulting probability factorization is q ψ ​ ( 𝐳 ) = ∏ r = 0 4 ​ T y − 1 ∏ i ∈ 𝒢 r q ψ ​ ( z i ∣ C i ) , q_{\psi}(\mathbf{z})=\prod_{r=0}^{4T_{y}-1}\prod_{i\in\mathcal{G}_{r}}q_{\psi}(z_{i}\mid C_{i}), (4) where 𝒢 r \mathcal{G}_{r} denotes the token positions predicted in round r r , and C i C_{i} is the available context. This scheme reduces sequential prediction to four rounds per latent frame.

blocks.en: 3.3 Joint Rate–Distortion Optimization
blocks.zh: 3.3 联合比率-扭曲优化

blocks.en:
The first two stages optimize the tokenizer and entropy model separately.
In Stage I, the tokenizer is optimized for reconstruction, without explicitly considering the coding cost of its token assignments.
In Stage II, entropy model learns to estimate the conditional probability of these tokens, but can only fit the token distribution without influencing it.
However, if the encoder produces tokens that are difficult to predict, improving the entropy model alone cannot fundamentally improve the compressibility of the learned representation.
blocks.zh:
前两个阶段分别优化了活化剂和 en模型.
处于阶段 一,标注器优化重建,未明确考虑其标注任务编码成本.
在"第二阶段"中, en模型学会了估计这些符符的有条件概率,但只能适应符符符的分布而不会影响.
然而,如果编码器产生出难以预测的活字,单是改进了 en模型并不能从根本上改善所学表现的可压缩性.

blocks.en:
To address this limitation, we adopt a differentiable rate surrogate [ 8 ] that allows rate gradients to propagate to the encoder through relaxed codeword assignments.
Specifically, we relax the non-differentiable hard assignment into a distance-based soft distribution over codebook entries: p soft ​ ( i , v ) = softmax v ⁡ ( − ‖ 𝐲 i − 𝐞 v ‖ 2 2 τ ) , p_{\mathrm{soft}}(i,v)=\operatorname{softmax}_{v}\left(-\frac{\left\lVert\mathbf{y}_{i}-\mathbf{e}_{v}\right\rVert_{2}^{2}}{\tau}\right), (6) where τ > 0 \tau>0 is the temperature.
This relaxation enables joint rate–distortion optimization of the tokenizer and entropy model, allowing token assignments to adapt toward lower conditional coding costs while preserving reconstruction quality.
In Stage III, we fix the codebook and jointly optimize the encoder, decoder, and entropy model using ℒ 3 = \displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{3}={} ℒ 1 + λ T ​ H ​ W ​ ∑ i = 1 N y ∑ v = 0 N − 1 p soft ​ ( i , v ) ​ [ − log 2 ⁡ q ψ ​ ( v ∣ C i ) ] . \displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{1}+\frac{\lambda}{THW}\sum_{i=1}^{N_{y}}\sum_{v=0}^{N-1}p_{\mathrm{soft}}(i,v)\left[-\log_{2}q_{\psi}\left(v\mid C_{i}\right)\right]. (7) Here, ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} is the reconstruction objective defined in Eq. 3 , and the second term provides a differentiable surrogate for coding rate.
Joint optimization allows the encoder to adapt its token assignments toward lower conditional coding costs while preserving reconstruction quality.

blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We train on OpenVid-HD [ 20 ] using the first 107 frames of each training video and random crops of 256 × 256 256\times 256 . We evaluate the first 96 frames on three benchmarks UVG [ 18 ] , HEVC Class B, and MCL-JCV [ 23 ] at 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 resolution.
blocks.zh: 我们在OpenVid-HD[20]上使用每台培训视频和256×256256\times 256的随机收成的前107帧来进行训练. 我们以1920×1080 1920\times 1080分辨率,对三个基准的UVG[18],HEVC B级和MCL-JCV[23]进行前96帧的评价.

blocks.en: We initialize the tokenizer from the pretrained MiniMax-H3 video VAE [ 19 ] and train on four NVIDIA H100 GPUs with a global batch size of 4. We use the Adam optimizer [ 9 ] with an initial learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , reduced to 10 − 6 10^{-6} using a cosine schedule. In Stage I, we train the discrete tokenizer with codebook size N = 4096 N=4096 and codeword dimension d = 24 d=24 using Eq. 3 for 60K steps. In Stage II, we freeze the tokenizer and train the entropy model with Eq. 5 for 20K steps. The entropy model uses 8 × 8 8\times 8 latent windows with four parity groups indexed by g ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } g\in\{0,1,2,3\} . Stage III jointly optimizes the tokenizer and entropy model with Eq. 7 for 20K additional steps, using the soft-assignment temperature τ = 0.05 \tau=0.05 and rate weights λ ∈ { 7.2 , 12 , 24 , 36 , 48 , 72 , 120 } \lambda\in\{7.2,12,24,36,48,72,120\} .

blocks.en:
We compare h3vc with traditional codecs HEVC [ 22 ] and VVC [ 1 ] , learned codecs DCVC-FM [ 11 ] and DCVC-RT [ 7 ] , and generative codecs PLVC [ 27 ] and GLC-Video [ 21 ] , GNVC-VD [ 15 ] , GVC1D [ 32 ] , and VoRTeC/VoRTeC+ [ 25 ] .
All learned baselines are evaluated using official implementations or author-reported results for fair comparison.
Following prior NVC studies, we evaluate the first 96 frames of each test sequence under a low-delay prediction configuration. All baselines are evaluated in RGB space.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了h3vc与传统编码器HEVC [22]和VVC [1],所学习的编码器DCVC-FM [11]和DCVC-RT [7],以及基因编码器PLVC [27]和GLC-Video [21],GNVC-VD [15],GVC1D [32],以及VORTEC/VORTEC+ [25].
利用正式执行或作者报告的结果评价所有获得的基线,以便进行公平比较。
继之前的NVC研究之后,我们在低延迟预测配置下对每个测试序列的前96个帧进行评估. 所有基线均在RGB空间内进行评估.

blocks.en:
Our evaluation covers perceptual rate–distortion performance, the discrete representation, entropy modeling, joint rate–distortion optimization, temporal reconstruction quality, and rate scalability. We compare perceptual RD curves using LPIPS [ 30 ] and DISTS [ 3 ] against bpp, complemented by qualitative reconstruction comparisons.
Following GNVC-VD [ 15 ] , we assess temporal consistency on natural videos using motion-compensated warping error E warp E_{\mathrm{warp}} and adjacent-frame CLIP-F. Our ablations examine the effects of pretrained Minimax-H3 weights, local and global entropy-model context, and Stage III joint rate–distortion optimization.
Additional analyses investigate codebook usage and token predictability, as well as prefix transmission.
blocks.zh:
我们的评价包括感知率 — — 扭曲性能、离散性表现、等同率 — — 扭曲性优化、时间重建质量和可伸缩性。 我们使用LPIPS[30]和DISTS[3]与bpp比较概念RD曲线,辅之以质量重建比较。
在GNVC-VD [15] 之后,我们利用运动补偿的扭曲误差(E-_{\mathrm{warp}})和相邻的框架CLIP-F来评估自然视频的时间一致性. 我们研究了预先受过训练的Minimax-H3重量、局部和全球的py模型背景以及第三阶段联合率-扭曲优化的效果。
其他分析调查了代码本的使用和象征的可预测性以及前缀传输.

blocks.en: 4.2 Perceptual Rate–Distortion Performance
blocks.zh: 4.2 观念率-扭曲 业绩

blocks.en: We compare h3vc with representative traditional, learned and generative video codecs on UVG [ 18 ] , MCL-JCV [ 23 ] , and HEVC-B. Figure 6 presents the perceptual rate–distortion performance measured by LPIPS and DISTS. h3vc consistently outperforms existing methods across all three datasets and different bitrates. Additionally, Table 3 summarizes BD-rate relative to GLC-Video [ 21 ] at matched LPIPS and DISTS. Compared with GLC-Video [ 21 ] , h3vc achieves bitrate savings of 82.2 % 82.2\% – 87.5 % 87.5\% in LPIPS and 78.3 % 78.3\% – 85.0 % 85.0\% in DISTS across the three datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们比较h3vc与具有代表性的传统,有学识和基因的视频编码在UVG [18],MCL-JCV [23],HEVC-B. 图6显示了由LPIPS和DISTS测量的感知率-扭曲性能. h3vc在所有三个数据集和不同的比特率上,一贯超越了现有方法. 此外,表3总结了与GLC-Video[21]对应的LPIPS和DISTS的BD率。 相较于GLC-Video [21],h3vc实现比特率节省82.2 % 82.2\% — —87.5% 87.5\%在LPIPS中,78.3% 78.3\% — —85.0% 85.0\%在DISTS中跨越了三个数据集.

blocks.en: 4.3 Pretrained Video Representations
blocks.zh: 4.3 预先培训的视频展示

blocks.en:
h3vc leverages the pretrained video representations of MiniMax-H3 for perceptual video compression.
To evaluate the contribution of these pretrained priors, we compare h3vc with a randomly initialized counterpart trained from scratch using the same architecture.
Figure 3 presents the perceptual rate–distortion curves on UVG. h3vc achieves a BD-LPIPS reduction of 66.96% over random initialization on UVG, demonstrating the benefit of pretrained video representations for ultra-low-bitrate perceptual compression.
blocks.zh:
h3vc利用MiniMax-H3的预训视频表现来进行感知视频压缩.
为了评估这些预训前科的贡献,我们用相同的架构来将h3vc与随机初始化的对应器进行比较.
图3显示紫外线上的感知率-扭曲曲线。 h3vc在UVG上实现了比随机初始化降低66.96%的BD-LPIPS,证明了预受训练的视频表达对超低比特率感知压缩的好处.

blocks.en: 4.4 Effectiveness of Entropy Modeling
blocks.zh: 4.4 环境模型的有效性

blocks.en: Our entropy model exploits dependencies among discrete video tokens to reduce their coding cost. Two key designs are local-global context modeling for accurate probability estimation and grouped prediction for parallel decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们的py模型利用离散视频符号的依赖性来降低它们的编码成本. 两种关键设计是局部-全球背景模型,用于准确概率估计和分组预测,用于平行解码。

blocks.en:
To evaluate the contribution of each context, we compare h3vc with variants that remove either local or global context under identical training and evaluation settings.
As shown in Table 4 , removing local context increases BD-rate at matched LPIPS by 18.2 % 18.2\% on UVG. Removing global context increases BD-rate at matched LPIPS-VGG by 0.64 % 0.64\% – 5.47 % 5.47\% across the three datasets, while reducing BD-rate at matched DISTS by 11.02 % 11.02\% – 17.76 % 17.76\% . These results show that local context improves coding efficiency on UVG, while the effect of global context depends on the perceptual metric.
blocks.zh:
为了评价每种情况的贡献,我们将h3vc与在相同的培训和评价环境中去除本地或全球情况的各种变体进行比较。
如表4所示,去除本地上下文后,在紫外线上比LPIPS的BD率提高了18.2% 18.2%。 移除全球背景可以将对应的LPIPS-VGG的BD率提高0.64 % , 0.64 % , 5.47 % , 5.47 % , 在三个数据集中,同时将对应的DISTS的BD率降低11.02% 11.02 % , 17.76 % 17.76 % 。 这些结果表明,本地环境提高了UVG的编码效率,而全球背景的影响取决于概念度量。

blocks.en: Table 5 compares grouping choices with a shared frozen tokenizer and parallel encoding. Relative to four groups, two groups reduce decoding latency by 13 % 13\% – 14 % 14\% but increase coding cost by 0.82 % 0.82\% – 1.53 % 1.53\% . Eight groups save only 0.59 % 0.59\% – 0.62 % 0.62\% in coding cost while increasing decoding latency by 22 % 22\% – 25 % 25\% . Increasing to 64 groups yields higher coding cost than eight groups and requires 2.81 2.81 – 2.91 × 2.91\times their decoding time. We therefore use four groups by default to balance coding efficiency and decoding latency. blocks.en:
We adopt a differentiable rate surrogate
that allows rate gradients to propagate to the encoder through relaxed
codeword assignments. This enables joint optimization of the token distribution and entropy model, encouraging the encoder to produce tokens that are more predictable under the entropy model. By adjusting the rate constraint, h3vc learns representations with different coding costs, yielding operating points at different bitrates.

blocks.en: To evaluate test-time rate adjustment, we compare full H3VC with predictive prefix completion, zero filling, and completion using separately trained tokenizer and entropy models (AE-Entropy), following RDVQ [ 8 ] . The prefix and zero-padding variants use the same λ = 7.2 \lambda=7.2 checkpoint and transmit the first k ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } k\in\{1,2,3\} spatial groups. Figure 9 shows that H3VC-Prefix achieves lower LPIPS and DISTS with fewer bits than both controls at each partial-transmission level, while quality decreases as fewer groups are transmitted. These results support using the entropy model as a completion prior for test-time bitrate adjustment without retraining.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented h3vc , a video compression framework that explores the potential of pretrained video VAE representations for video compression.
Particularly at ultra-low bitrates, compact spatiotemporal representations provide an effective way to exploit spatial and temporal redundancies while preserving perceptually important details. To enable flexible bitrate control, we introduce a categorical entropy model and jointly optimize it with the tokenizer, adapting token distributions and their predictability to achieve different compression rates.
Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate superior perceptual rate–distortion performance over traditional, learned, and generative video codecs, as well as improved temporal coherence compared with existing generative methods. h3vc offers a new perspective on video compression, highlighting the potential of pretrained video representations and categorical entropy modeling for efficient perceptual coding.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了h3vc, 一个视频压缩框架,
特别是在超低比特率时,紧凑的spatiotal表示法为利用空间和时间冗余提供了有效的方法,同时保留了感知上重要的细节. 为了实现灵活的比特率控制,我们引入了一种绝对的 en模型,并与活化器共同优化它,调整了活化物分布及其可预测性来达到不同的压缩率.
跨越多个基准的广泛实验表明,比起传统、有学问和基因分解的视频分解器来说,超强的认知率-扭曲性能,以及与现有基因分解方法相比,时间一致性也有所改善。 h3vc为视频压缩提供了新的视角,凸显了预先训练的视频表现和断断续续的entropy模型对于高效的知觉编码的潜力.
